purpose: Temporary local diagnostic indexing only. No book text is committed; this manifest holds metadata and hashes only.
selectionCriteria: Ten distinct authors; original Spanish (no translations); authors died 1616–1937; periods from the Golden Age to the 20th century; Spain, Argentina and Uruguay; novel, epistolary novel, narrative verse and short stories; naturally occurring lengths (no padding). Works were selected on rights and diversity before any measurement.
normalizationProcedure: 0) Bytes are used exactly as served (CRLF line endings preserved, as the production fetcher stores them). 1) Verify acquiredSha256. 2) Apply production GutenbergFetcherService.stripHeaders (START/END markers, then trim); verify strippedSha256. 3) Keep code points [keepCodePoints[0], keepCodePoints[1]) (removes the listed editorial material). 4) Remove '[Illustration...]' blocks. 5) Trim. Implemented by services/api/tests/perf/e1-literary-diag.ts prepare.
